question: 2025年GMV同比2024年是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025) AS y2025, (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2024) AS y2024

question: 2025年订单数相比2024年如何？
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025) AS y2025, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2024) AS y2024

question: 2025年上半年GMV与2024年上半年对比
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.month<=6) AS y2025_h1, (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2024 AND d.month<=6) AS y2024_h1

question: 2025年Q1的GMV和2024年Q1比是多少
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.quarter='Q1') AS y2025_q1, (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2024 AND d.quarter='Q1') AS y2024_q1

question: 2025年12月GMV同比2024年12月
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.month=12) AS y2025_m12, (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2024 AND d.month=12) AS y2024_m12

question: 2025年销量同比2024年
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(f.order_quantity) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025) AS y2025, (SELECT SUM(f.order_quantity) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2024) AS y2024

question: 2025年华东GMV同比2024年
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id=r.region_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND r.region_name='华东') AS y2025, (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id=r.region_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2024 AND r.region_name='华东') AS y2024

question: 2025年手机数码GMV与2024年对比
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id=p.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND p.category='手机数码') AS y2025, (SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id=p.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2024 AND p.category='手机数码') AS y2024

question: 排除退款订单，2025年第一季度已支付GMV是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.quarter='Q1' AND f.order_status='已支付'

question: 只统计已支付订单的销售额
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f WHERE f.order_status='已支付'

question: 退款订单有多少笔？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS 退款订单数 FROM fact_order WHERE order_status='已退款'

question: 2025年退款率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_status='已退款')/COUNT(*) AS 退款率 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025

question: 排除退款和取消后2024年的净GMV
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS 净GMV FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2024 AND f.order_status='已支付'

question: 已取消订单的数量
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS 已取消 FROM fact_order WHERE order_status='已取消'

question: 华东地区已支付的GMV
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(f.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id=r.region_id WHERE r.region_name='华东' AND f.order_status='已支付'

question: 已退款订单的销售额合计
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) AS 退款金额 FROM fact_order WHERE order_status='已退款'

question: 再按省份拆分
gold_sql: SELECT r.province AS 省份, SUM(f.order_amount) AS GMV FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id=r.region_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 GROUP BY r.province

question: 只看华东地区

question: 只看2025年

question: 再按品牌拆分
